$note: Runtime gateway settings that are neither secrets nor plan-specific.
$api_origin_note: The portal calls the gateway same-origin when the gateway serves the page. When the portal is served by a static host (e.g. the Vercel deployment of apps/web/dist), the client falls back to this origin, which must be a deployment of gateway/. Keep it pointing at a live gateway.

cors_public_api.expose: X-Request-Id, X-Upstream-Request-Id, X-API-Version, X-Gateway-Version, X-Plan, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, X-Quota-Limit, X-Quota-Remaining, X-Quota-Reset
